summary: General Catalyst Global Resilience Merger Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 40,250,000 GRAIL securities at $10.00 per unit, each comprising one Class A ordinary share and one-fourth of a warrant exercisable at $11.50. Concurrently, sponsor GCGR Sponsor LLC purchased 905,000 private placement units at the same price. Net proceeds of $402.5 million were deposited into a trust account for public shareholders and underwriters. The registrant is a blank-check company (Cayman Islands) with a business combination mandate. Key watch items: identifying a target within 24 months and potential shareholder redemption dynamics. No business combination or agreement has been announced, making this a SPAC IPO event.
